assets.prompt: Wide establishing shot concept art for a 3D adventure platformer video game, stylised realism like a modern adventure game. A colossal tropical waterfall pours down a towering dark basalt cliff into a turquoise plunge pool. Flat wet rock ledges and stepping stones jut out of the cliff face at staggered heights like a natural staircase, some covered in lush green moss, with fallen logs wedged between rocks. Thick white mist and spray at the base, warm god rays cutting through the mist from the upper left, dense jungle foliage framing the sides. A small athletic human adventurer in simple outdoor clothes is captured mid-jump between two ledges halfway up, tiny against the scale of the falls. Painterly but detailed, rich saturated greens and teals, cinematic lighting, high detail, no text, no UI.
assets.usedIn: Art direction reference; planned loading / title screen backdrop (Phase 7) and trailer ingredient (Phase 9)

assets.prompt: Ultra-wide seamless panoramic sky and landscape for a video game skybox, equirectangular style, horizon line exactly in the vertical middle of the image and perfectly level. Upper half: bright tropical morning sky, soft blue with scattered warm-lit cumulus clouds and a hazy sun low on the left. Lower half: rolling distant jungle-covered hills and misty valleys fading into atmospheric haze, receding in layers. No waterfall, no river, no buildings, no people, no foreground objects, no text. Left and right edges match so the panorama wraps seamlessly. Stylised realism, painterly, soft atmospheric perspective, same style as a modern adventure game.
assets.notes: Flow has no 2:1 ratio. Generated at 16:9 (1376x768) and stretched to 2048x1024 for the game.
assets.usedIn: Background sky sphere

assets.prompt: Character reference sheet (turnaround) for a 3D video game model. One athletic young adult adventurer shown three times at the same scale in a row: front view, side profile view, and back view. Standing upright in a strict T-pose with arms straight out horizontally and legs slightly apart, neutral expression. Simple practical outdoor clothes: fitted rust-orange short-sleeve shirt, dark olive cargo trousers, sturdy brown hiking boots, short dark hair, no backpack, no weapons, no accessories. Full body visible head to toe in every view, feet on the same baseline. Plain flat mid-grey background, even flat studio lighting, no shadows, no text, no labels. Stylised realism like a modern adventure game character.
assets.usedIn: Modelling / image-to-3D reference for the player character (Phase 6)

assets.prompt: Static locked-off tripod shot, camera does not move at all, no zoom, no pan. A very distant tall tropical waterfall seen from far away across a misty jungle valley, a thin white ribbon of water falling continuously down a dark basalt cliff in the centre of the frame, surrounded by dense green jungle hills. Soft morning haze, gentle drifting mist at the base of the falls, faint god rays, a few leaves swaying very slightly. Nothing else changes: no people, no animals, no birds, no clouds moving quickly, constant lighting from start to finish so the clip loops seamlessly. Stylised realism, painterly, like a modern adventure game. Ambient waterfall sound only, no music, no speech.
assets.processing: ffmpeg: last second cross-faded into the first second for a seamless 6.9 s loop, audio removed, H.264 CRF 25, 1280x720, 1.0 MB.
assets.usedIn: Title screen backdrop and distant background plane (Phase 7)

assets.prompt: Visual effects element on a pure solid black background. Static locked-off camera, side view at water level. A single burst of white water splashes straight upward from the bottom centre of the frame, as if a heavy object has just dropped into water: a crown-shaped splash rises, spreads into droplets and fine spray, then falls back down and fades away completely to empty black by the end. Only white water and spray are visible, no water surface, no pool, no object, no ground, no horizon, no reflections. The background stays perfectly black the whole time. High contrast, crisp droplets, slow enough to see the shape clearly. No sound needed.
assets.notes: The clip shows a waterline with an underwater plume despite the prompt. Only the region above the waterline is used, so no second attempt was spent.
assets.processing: ffmpeg: 1.3 s to 4.0 s, cropped to 744x372 above the waterline, desaturated, blacks crushed, 16 frames tiled 4x4 into a 1024x512 sprite sheet (256x128 cells).
assets.usedIn: Pool splash flipbook (src/components/Splash.tsx)

assets.prompt: Animation reference footage. Static locked-off camera, exact side view, wide enough that the whole body stays in frame from head to feet for the entire clip. An athletic adult in a plain rust-orange t-shirt, dark olive trousers and hiking boots runs from the left across a large flat rock, takes off from its edge with one foot, makes a clear running jump across a gap of about two metres, lands on a second flat rock on the right, absorbs the landing with bent knees and stands up. One continuous take, real-time speed, natural athletic movement, no slow motion, no cuts, no camera movement. Plain uncluttered outdoor background with soft even daylight so the silhouette is easy to read. No music, no speech.
assets.usedIn: Animation reference / possible video-mocap input for the jump (Phase 6). Not shipped in the game.

assets.prompt: Built procedurally with Python through the MCP for Blender addon. Scripts: assets-src/blender/cascade_lib.py and step1_materials_cliff.py, step2_rocks.py, step3_ground_logs_sheet.py, step4_export.py. Layout comes from assets-src/level_layout.json, which is generated from src/level/greybox.ts.
assets.contents: Cliff_Main, 14 ledges + 2 stepping stones + 6 boulders as instances of five rock shapes (Rock_A to Rock_E, 1,536 tris each), Summit, Bank_L, Bank_R, Shore, Pool_Basin, Log_A, Log_B, Waterfall_Sheet (UVs top to bottom), and 30 box colliders named <Object>_COL with surface / checkpoint / finish custom properties.
assets.budget: 121,557 visual triangles including foliage, scanned rocks and tree cards (budget 150,000); textures 1024 px; glb about 5.6 MB with Draco meshes and WebP textures.
assets.usedIn: The whole playable level (src/level/useLevelModel.ts, Level.tsx, Logs.tsx, waterfall/Waterfall.tsx)

assets.file: assets-src/raw/mixamo/ (Megan_TPose.fbx, Idle.fbx, Run.fbx, Jump.fbx, Falling.fbx, Landing.fbx; not committed)
assets.prompt: No prompt. Mixamo stock character 'Megan' (FBX Binary, T-pose) with the animations 'Idle', 'Running' (In Place), 'Jump' (Jumping In Place), 'Falling Idle' and 'Falling To Landing', each downloaded as FBX, Without Skin, 30 fps, no keyframe reduction.
assets.processing: Blender (assets-src/blender/char1_import.py, char2_animations.py, char3_optimize_export.py): clips joined onto one armature as actions Idle / Run / Jump / Fall / Land on separate NLA tracks; upward hip travel removed from Jump and Land so physics alone moves the player; meshes decimated from 54,961 to 14,405 triangles and joined; textures reduced from 4096 / 2048 to 1024; exported as Draco glb with WebP textures.
